data.summary:
GitHub account alienvisitor8675-bit (display name "Tony"; created Aug 14, 2026; 336 public repos) opens pull requests titled "AI Agent Fix for Issue #N" on issues that carry a bounty. Each PR body ends with "Automated solution generated by Tony.", a request to "proceed with the payment", and a list of payout wallets (BTC bc1q3zf55dn7zxy0gvpaak2qqncm2j6z47szx4c8z8, ETH 0xec27De22C1cB74b6a63209C153F080a1657709b2, SOL 2dXMPU4NpTSydkM5BfxSEGStv5qayAFV6kFsNGSSrtbw). Some ask for PayPal instead.

Volume (GitHub search, Oct 29): 691 PRs since Aug 14. 17 merged, 472 closed without merging, 202 still open. 16 were opened on Oct 29 alone. 13 of the 17 merged PRs are in Lilly-Protocol repos (agentlily-runtime 6, lily-sdk 4, lily-contracts 3).

Maintainers' responses:
- BasedHardware/omi: all 172 of Tony's PRs were closed without merging.
- Scottcjn/rustchain-bounties #17112: "Closing as spam. `ai_solution.py` is a markdown essay about sums of squares. It has nothing to do with #16512 and changes nothing in this repo." The maintainer adds that six more PRs of the same kind are open.
- On the bounty-relay bot alfrexo95/bounty-bot, a user opened issue #38, "Stop": "Please don't go around doing this, it sucks".

The surrounding ecosystem: bot-generated bounty repos (BountyScout clones; zhangjiayang6835-cyber/bounty-plaza, 775 issues and no merged PRs; alfrexo95/bounty-bot relays) are answered by bot PR farmers. Tony is the main one: since Oct 1, 250 PRs carry "Automated solution generated by", and Tony wrote all 100 of the most recent. 359 PRs since Oct 1 carry "Payout Wallet Addresses"; other farmers using that footer include sonson0910 and huangji6693-max.

On-chain: on Sep 15, 2026 the ETH wallet received 18.972013 USDC from 0xf70da97812CB96acDF810712Aa562db8dfA3dbEF (tx 0xc3cfd6f691d29d5cb91232ed82fce2d8e0d1eac43cc71e4bda1d7ad0be7279aa, 07:27 UTC). It sent the same amount to the MetaMask Swaps contract at 21:28 UTC (tx 0x446c2b3fb7bd08917f2e95e13f1667d0716c362b74722f1bc917debcb5af9e21). The sender looks like a shared or exchange wallet, so the payer can't be identified. Calling this a bounty payout is an inference.

Unpaid bounties at Lilly-Protocol (context): Lilly-Protocol, an agent-finance organization, merged dozens of bounty PRs in early September. Contributors then filed settlement requests that are still open, e.g. lily-sdk #575 (TheCriners, 23 merged PRs, $1,155), #576 (aEMPTYCUP, 3 PRs) and #577 ($90 for woahwhattheheck; also agentlily-runtime #394). Tony is among the claimants. Whether Lilly-Protocol is agent-run or a deliberate honeypot is unproven.

Uncertainties: who runs Tony and which model it uses are unknown, and its GitHub bio presents it as a human developer. It is an AI agent only by its own description ("AI Agent Fix", "Automated solution generated by Tony"). The harm proven so far is maintainer time and spam; there is no proven theft. Earlier coverage discusses AI bounty-farming in general, but I found none that names these accounts.
